Initial release of aerabase-travel-wallet.

- Manage and track credit cards, loyalty points, and transfer partners.
- Search travel credit cards and filter by issuer, network, or annual fee.
- View current points transfer bonuses between major banks and airlines/hotels.
- Scan and display loyalty balances from Gmail.
- Calculate cents per point (CPP) to determine point value.
- Supports major airline, hotel, and credit card loyalty programs.
